ablation_policy: run seven small-scale variants on seeds 104-105 only if development candidate passes

criteria.A: all correctness, hash, cross-validation and budget checks pass
criteria.B: equal Primary: no instance median >1% worse; at least two instances >=2% better
criteria.C: equal time: no instance median >1% worse; at least two instances >=3% better
criteria.D: EPRK unit Primary <=10x HGA; w60 RSS <2GB; route evaluations/Primary <100; Direction DP/Primary <20
criteria.E: both seeds successful without abnormal early stop

development_gate.equal_time_rule: max(30 seconds, 10 * median HGA atomic wall time at 5000 Primary) per instance

holdout_policy: run seeds 106-110 only after all development-gate criteria pass and candidate profile is frozen; never tune after viewing
primary_budget_semantics: every complete system candidate evaluation request consumes one Primary, including phenotype-cache hits
